title: The origins of inoculation
locator: Sections on Ottoman/European inoculation, China and India, and Conclusions; complete article text inspected.
scope_limit: Historical inquiry through reports and older scholarship; early origins, coverage and precise identity/geography of informants remain contested. No reported risk ratio is adopted.
evidence_lineage: Reproduces Timonius, Mather/Onesimus, Pylarinius, North African and other accounts; depends on Needham and earlier historical compilations. Not independent inspection of those original manuscripts. Overlaps the Montagu narrative in MED-S02.

title: Mandating immunity in the Ottoman Empire: A history of public health education and compulsory vaccination
locator: Sections 1–5; full XML body inspected via Europe PMC after PMC browser challenge.
scope_limit: Analysis of official texts and institutional history; prescriptions cannot establish achieved coverage, enforcement frequency or recipients' beliefs.
evidence_lineage: Original scholarly reading of Menafiü’l-Etfal (1846), Ottoman regulations and related historical literature. Those original Ottoman documents were not separately inspected here; reported delivery limits also use cited histories.

title: On the Antiseptic Principle in the Practice of Surgery (1867; 2010 reprint)
locator: 2010 reprint, Clinical Orthopaedics and Related Research 468:2012–2016; clinical body and concluding ward discussion inspected through public HTML retrieval.
scope_limit: Author's clinical advocacy, changing practice and case observations, not a controlled effect estimate; original BMJ scan was located but not separately read.
evidence_lineage: Reprint of Lister's 1867 address; same author and case-report tradition examined by MED-S04 and MED-S05, which are interpretive rereadings rather than independent clinical replications.

title: Joseph Lister and the performance of antiseptic surgery
locator: pp. 199–209; introduction and Antiseptic performance, Surgical performance, Professional performance sections inspected.
scope_limit: Reconstructs practice and communication; does not estimate a diffusion curve or isolate professional incentives quantitatively.
evidence_lineage: Rereads Lister publications/lectures and uses historical work by Crowther, Dupree, Lawrence, Dixey and Schlich. Shares Lister material with MED-S03 and MED-S05.

title: Statistics and the British controversy about the effects of Joseph Lister’s system of antisepsis for surgery, 1867–1890
locator: James Lind Library 2014 version; introduction, case reports, statistics, Glasgow Royal Infirmary and longer-term perspective sections inspected.
scope_limit: The 2014 JLL version is the inspected work, not an assertion of having inspected the later journal edition. Some selection arguments are historians' interpretations.
evidence_lineage: Uses Lister's reports plus Hamilton's reconstruction of Glasgow Royal Infirmary records and other scholarship; Hamilton original not separately inspected. Overlaps MED-S03/S04; comparisons are not independent trials.

title: Watersheds in Child Mortality: The Role of Effective Water and Sewerage Infrastructure, 1880–1920
locator: JPE 127:586–638, corrected reprint; pp. 586–593, introduction to identification/results, Table 4 and robustness discussion pp. 612–614 inspected; appendices not audited in full.
scope_limit: Difference-in-differences for Massachusetts municipalities; Boston excluded from estimation; contingent on rollout exogeneity, mortality registration, interference and model assumptions.
evidence_lineage: Massachusetts vital records, municipal infrastructure histories and state/federal census data; distinct regional design from MED-S07, but historically related water systems/literature. Not independent universal replication of city-level national estimates.

title: Re-Examining the Contribution of Public Health Efforts to the Decline in Urban Mortality (July 2019 manuscript)
locator: July 2019 manuscript; introduction/background, §3 pp. 8–9, §6 pp. 17–18 and conclusion pp. 19–20 inspected.
scope_limit: Working-paper version, not the 2022 final article. Reported estimates and corrections are not independently reproduced. Observational city panel; correlated interventions and denominators matter.
evidence_lineage: Uses US Census Mortality Statistics and Vital Statistics plus intervention histories; reproduces and modifies Cutler–Miller original data/specification. MED-S08 responds within this shared-record dispute; not independent corroborating datasets.

title: Reexamining the Contribution of Public Health Efforts to the Decline in Urban Mortality: Comment
locator: AEA journal abstract and bibliographic record, pp. 158–165; full article not acquired.
scope_limit: Supports only the existence and authors' stated nature of the disagreement, not adjudication or verification of their calculations.
evidence_lineage: Reanalysis of the original Cutler–Miller municipal mortality panel in response to Anderson–Charles–Rees. Shared historical records and disputed coding with MED-S07, not independent replication.

title: Penicillin Production through Deep-tank Fermentation
authors: American Chemical Society, National Historic Chemical Landmarks
locator: The Penicillin Problem; Pfizer’s Growth with Citric Acid and Fermentation; Development of Deep-tank Fermentation; Penicillin Production by Deep-tank Fermentation.
scope_limit: Commemorative institutional/company-centred account; useful process sequence, weak basis for exclusive priority, causal weights, national totals or welfare estimates.
evidence_lineage: ACS landmark account drawing on Pfizer history and materials; detailed archival genealogy not reconstructed. Shares the familiar wartime production narrative with MED-S10, so corroboration is not wholly independent.

title: The Rescue of Penicillin
authors: US Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service
locator: Entire short feature, especially paragraphs on Florey/Heatley visit, culture medium and strain work in 1941–1942.
scope_limit: Institutional retrospective celebrating USDA; no production series or primary laboratory records inspected. Avoid uncorroborated sole-credit language and anecdotes about strain discovery.
evidence_lineage: Institutional history of the Northern Regional Research Laboratory; underlying laboratory notebooks not provided/inspected. Overlaps MED-S09 on transatlantic wartime collaboration.

title: Analysis of Historical Trends and Recent Elimination of Malaria from Sri Lanka and Its Applicability for Malaria Control in Other Countries
locator: Abstract; Malaria in Sri Lanka During the Second Half of the Twentieth Century; Resurgence 1980–2000; Polonnaruwa epidemic sections inspected.
scope_limit: Retrospective mini-review with some authors' own observations; causal labels such as complacency are interpretations. Ancient origins and epidemic totals outside this case are not adopted.
evidence_lineage: Anti-Malaria Campaign historical data and cited government/research accounts plus authors' local research. Overlaps some Sri Lankan narrative/records underlying MED-S12 and institutional account MED-S16.

title: Malaria resurgence: a systematic review and assessment of its causes
locator: Methods; Reported causes of resurgence; Weakening of the malaria control programme; Technical problems; Discussion/limitations.
scope_limit: Counts attributed causes in selected published events; overlapping categories, reporting bias, heterogeneous magnitudes and limited causal evidence. No causal probabilities inferred.
evidence_lineage: Original systematic review of 208 reports describing 75 events; a secondary synthesis of individual outbreaks. Its Sri Lanka subcase overlaps source traditions in MED-S11 rather than adding independent observations.

title: Magic bullet: the history of oral rehydration therapy
locator: Medical History 38:363–397; methodological introduction pp. 363–365 and implementation/interpretation pp. 389–393 inspected in parsed PDF.
scope_limit: Retrospective interviews with scientific participants; claims of unique discovery, priority and entire medical profession's motives not taken as settled. Not a complete clinical-trial audit.
evidence_lineage: Original oral-history interviews and contemporary research articles. Ruxin cites Nalin, Cash, Mahalanabis and other investigators; scientific participants also appear in MED-S14, producing partly shared insider perspectives.

title: The status of ORT in Bangladesh: how widely is it used?
locator: Health Policy and Planning 12:58–66; methods, Box 1, Tables 1–3, Discussion pp. 64–65. Full public text and publisher PDF parsed tables inspected; no page-by-page visual audit.
scope_limit: 1993 survey of 90 villages in BRAC programme cohorts, two-week recalled episodes; broad ORT measure includes home fluids. Abstract and Table 2 differ; no randomized programme-effect identification.
evidence_lineage: Original household/provider/shop survey and chemical testing of 269 prepared solutions; investigators include programme personnel. Earlier programme reach and comparison rates inherited from earlier BRAC studies not independently inspected.

title: Addressing Antibiotic Abuse in China: An Experimental Audit Study
locator: J Dev Econ 110:39–51, author manuscript; §§I–IV, especially §III study design and experiment scripts, plus stated results and limitations inspected.
scope_limit: One unnamed large city, October 2011–June 2012; young healthy standardized patients; encounter prescribing, not resistance outcomes or system-wide reform. Auditors knew study purpose.
evidence_lineage: Original two audit experiments: 320 visits/80 physicians then 300 visits/120 physicians; randomly assigned roles and ordering. Discussion also cites earlier audits, which are not counted as separately inspected evidence.

title: Address by Regional Director on the occasion of Malaria Elimination Certification by the Government of Sri Lanka
authors: WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia
locator: 30 November 2016 speech; certification announcement paragraph and first six listed institutional factors inspected.
scope_limit: Contemporaneous official certification account, also celebratory; causal explanation is institutional interpretation, not controlled evaluation. No current status claim is made.
evidence_lineage: WHO certification and Sri Lankan programme reporting; specific underlying certification dossier not inspected. Shares programme history with MED-S11; independent public confirmation of the dated announcement, not independent incidence measurement.
